tournament.name: October OCC - Qualifier B
tournament.description: Participation Confirmation deadline: October 8th Qualifier Brackets - October 9th @ 1300 GMT (deck list deadline October 9th @ 1200 GMT) - The qualifier brackets are seeded based on the position of the player on the OC leader-board at the end of the season. Round of 8 Finals - October 17th @ 1300 GMT (deck list deadline October 14th @ 2300 GMT) -The Round of 8 Finals are seeded based on OC leaderboard at the end of the season in addition to the final 2 qualified players being positioned in #7 and #8.
